visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Colour jumps instead of fading
visualizerParams.problemDescription: This link is meant to fade to orange over half a second, but the colour changes instantly. The transition has no duration, so it takes no time.
visualizerParams.buggyCode: Hover me

solution.code: Hover me
solution.explanation: A transition needs a duration. Without one the duration is 0s and the change is immediate. Write the property and the time together: transition: color 0.5s.

checks.label: The fade takes half a second
